notes: Abu Salama and Abu Abdullah are co-transmitters, both hearing «أنهما سمعا أبا هريرة يقول»; «مولى الجهنيين» (patron) and «من أصحاب أبي هريرة» (remark) are left out of the surfaces

needs_ruling: the report then tells a second chain for the saying «فإني آخر الأنبياء وإنه آخر المساجد» (عبد الله بن إبراهيم بن قارظ, relayed from Abu Hurayra) inside a story of Abu Salama and Abu Abdullah's doubt; whether it is a second route or a second saying is not settled by the rules, so it is not read as one here
